commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question 'How long should deleted notes stay in the trash before auto-purge?' \
  --context 'Trash keeps notes forever and storage doubled. The purge age sets what support can still restore.
**7 days:** about $5/month; restores after week 1 fail.
**30 days:** about $20/month; covers 85% of restore requests.
**90 days:** about $60/month; covers nearly all restores.' \
  --option '7 days' --option '30 days' --option '90 days' --recommended '30 days' \
  --waiting
